video_caption: The video segment showcases a person engaged in subzero bushcraft in Alberton, Prince Edward Island, Canada, during 2015. The environment is a snowy forest landscape under a sunny sky. The person, likely unseen but speaking, is constructing a "Lean-to Tipi Type Struktur" (Lean-to Tipi Type Structure) to have enough clearance for a fire, with the intention of staying overnight. The structure is built around a fallen evergreen tree, which is being reinforced with smaller tree trunks and filled in with evergreen branches. The video shows close-ups of the structure, the snow-covered forest, and the person's snowshoes. There are visible texts at the bottom of the screen that read "Alberton - Prince Edward Island - Canada Sub Zero Bushcraft 2015" and "Lean-to Tipi Type Struktur To have enough clearance for a fire".
